input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 is a symmetrical consent-based prohibition. It gives Client only a limited "financially responsible affiliate" carve-out with no successor/M&A carve-out, so a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of Client's assets would require TrueLink's consent, and the consent standard is unqualified (TrueLink could withhold arbitrarily). Conversely, TrueLink's assignment is not barred from going to a Client competitor. There is no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right anywhere in the Agreement (no "change of control" language appears), so no walk-away issue, but the clause falls short of the preferred position and is a high-severity assignment deviation. Redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out for Client, a reasonableness standard on Client's consent to TrueLink assignments, a no-competitor restriction, and confirms a Client change of control triggers no vendor right.

proposal.summary: Add Client affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, reasonableness standard on Client consent, no assignment to a Client competitor, and no vendor right arising from Client change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We revised the assignment clause so that we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent, while TrueLink's assignment remains subject to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and may never be to a competitor of ours. We also confirmed that a change of control of Client gives TrueLink no termination or re-pricing right; if helpful, we can accept a mutual successor-assignment right with written notice instead.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Client may assign or transfer this Agreement and any of its rights and obligations hereunder, without the prior approval of TrueLink, to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets. TrueLink shall not assign or transfer any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written approval of Client, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Client. No change of control of Client shall constitute an assignment or give TrueLink any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
